title: Constructivism — An Idea Becomes a Connected System

scenes.title: Idea to system
scenes.purpose: A single idea (a halftone bulb cutout) is driven up a -12° Constructivist axis, slashed by a red band carrying the headline, and recomposed into the hub of a four-node network.
visuals: Stationary ink-navy ground with low-value sunburst wedges radiating from the future hub and static grain
Procedural halftone light-bulb cutout revealed by a diagonal SVG clip wipe
Construction-red band on the -12° axis with off-white Impact headline
Red hub ring, off-white spokes and square nodes (one red)
Black caption strip with hairline rules and spaced caps; corner kicker and metadata

beats.development: The halftone bulb cutout wipes in behind a slanted mask edge and travels up the axis. The kicker 'FROM ONE IDEA' slides in.
The red band slashes in left to right along the -12° axis. Once it is complete, the headline rises inside it.
Recomposition: the bulb drops its base and travels up the same diagonal behind the band, shrinking into the hub. The red ring draws closed around it.
Four spokes draw outward from the hub, and each square node lands as its spoke arrives. The black caption strip and its rules cut in along the axis, then the caption rises. Corner metadata appears.
The final lockup holds still for reading.

findings: The headline is fully legible from 1.32 s, giving about 1.7 s of reading time.
All motion follows one -12° directional structure: the wipe, the bulb's travel, the band and the strip.
Container-first rule: the headline appears only after the band; the caption only after the strip; each node only after its spoke finishes.
justifiedHolds: 2.62–3.0 s: a final settled hold so the full lockup can be read.

notes: The photographic cutout is a procedural halftone approximation, not a real photograph.
The palette is scene-dependent (ink navy / off-white / construction red), following the reference's palette roles.
